name: Verena Holt
source_profile:
Verena Holt (LN) — Town Reeve

Verena is the marquessa's appointed municipal administrator, responsible for taxation, commercial licenses, property registration, and the administration of timber concessions. A capable and ambitious former clerk in the commercial offices of northern Cador, she possesses considerable experience negotiating contracts and organizing large-scale enterprises.

She enjoys the confidence of Elowen Harrowmont, who values her efficiency and willingness to enforce difficult decisions without becoming distracted by local political concerns. Verena believes that Thornhollow's prosperity depends upon attracting substantial investment and establishing a reliable system for regulating timber extraction. In her view, the settlement's older informal arrangements are inadequate to manage an industry upon which much of the kingdom's reconstruction now depends.

Her responsibilities have brought her into frequent disagreement with Edrik Hallow and representatives of the Briarhearth Freeholds, who challenge the marquisate's authority to issue concessions over lands their families have occupied for generations. Verena acknowledges that some grievances may be legitimate, but considers the continued refusal of these communities to recognize Cadorian authority increasingly impractical.
